title: SCORE-LM: State-Space Radar Representations with Language Models for Fault Diagnosis
abstract: arXiv:2609.38980v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radar hardware faults threaten automated perception, motivating accurate, compact diagnosis and understandable maintenance guidance. We introduce SCORE-LM, which couples a small scatterer-conditioned operator-response encoder (SCORE) to an adapted local language model. SCORE combines self-referenced complex trajectories, physical descriptors, and a selective state-space branch, with source-only self-supervision and directional fault inference. On eight capture-excluded Rad-R fault recordings, it achieves state-of-the-art performance within the evaluated nine-model comparison: 88.39% mean capture recall and 88.20% four-fault macro-F1 at ten frames. Its 39,520 radar inference coefficients are 119.7 times fewer than RadrNet-DS-CI's, while recall is 15.56 percentage points higher than this strongest competitor. translated_title: SCORE-LM：基于状态空间雷达表征与语言模型的故障诊断方法
translated_abstract: 雷达硬件故障威胁着自动化感知系统，这促使人们需要精确、紧凑的故障诊断和易于理解的维护指导。我们提出了SCORE-LM，它将一个小型的散射体条件化算子响应编码器（SCORE）与一个适配的本地语言模型相耦合。SCORE融合了自参照复数轨迹、物理描述符以及一个选择性状态空间分支，并采用仅源域自监督学习和方向性故障推断。在八个排除采集的Rad-R故障录音数据上，该方法在所评估的九个模型对比中取得了最先进的性能：在十帧条件下达到88.39%的平均捕获召回率和88.20%的四故障宏F1分数。其39,520个雷达推理系数比RadrNet-DS-CI少119.7倍，而召回率却比这一最强竞争对手高出15.56个百分点。在另一项低标签协议实验中，SCORE在每类仅使用一个标注源窗口的情况下达到了71.58%的召回率。一个非线性投影器收敛
tldr: SCORE-LM将紧凑的状态空间雷达编码器与本地语言模型相结合，以比最强竞争对手少119.7倍的推理系数实现了最先进的雷达硬件故障诊断性能，且在极低标签条件下仍保持较高召回率。
en_tdlr: SCORE-LM couples a compact state-space radar encoder with a local language model, achieving state-of-the-art radar fault diagnosis with 119.7 times fewer inference coefficients than the strongest competitor and robust performance under extremely low-label conditions.
